# Tests left out of the default pass of the GPU suite, one `PATTERN | REASON` per line (gtest
# patterns, several joined with `:`). It is counted as not applicable in the test report, with this
# reason, and it is not run in this pass.
#
# A test that exists only on some backends is registered only there (test/TestRegistration.hpp), so
# it is not listed here. This list holds what is left: a test that is present on the backend and
# does not apply to it for another reason, such as the hardware it needs.
#
# A pattern that matches no test is an error (see .github/scripts/run_gtest.py).

P2PTransferTest.MultiGPUIfAvailable* | Need two or more GPUs; the runner has one
